name: MelodyMachine wav2vec2 deepfake-audio detector
reason: Measured locally (2026-09-21) and rejected in both export paths. ONNX export saturates to a single class on all inputs (edge-TTS fakes AND LibriSpeech reals both logit[1]~1.0). HF hub path (hf-audio-classifier, MelodyMachine/Deepfake-audio-detection-V2, id2label {0:fake,1:real}) scores real speech higher on the fake axis than TTS (yesno 73 vs edge_ko 50) — inverted/unusable. The onnx-audio runtime stays wired for future candidates.
limitations: This profile never produces scores; it exists to document the measured rejection.
Existing measured audio members remain aasist + wav2vec XLSR.
